inspection_types.name: Casual Inspection
inspection_types.purpose: Quickly identify abnormal conditions, debris, or obvious traffic obstacles.

inspection_types.name: Routine Inspection
inspection_types.purpose: Check general element condition and identify early-stage maintenance needs.
inspection_types.equipment: Visual inspection checklist, measuring tape, crack card.
inspection_types.deliverable: Routine Inspection Report with Element Status

inspection_types.name: Regular Inspection
inspection_types.purpose: Systematic damage mapping, defect measurement, and maintenance quantification.
inspection_types.equipment: BMS Mobile Client (MC), CAD drawing tablets, optical crack microscopes.
inspection_types.deliverable: Full Inspection Report & As-built Drawing Defect Overlay

inspection_types.name: Principal Inspection
inspection_types.purpose: Comprehensive structural safety and load carrying capacity assessment.
inspection_types.equipment: Under-bridge inspection units (UBIU), ultrasonic pulse, rebound hammer, coring, half-cell potential.
inspection_types.deliverable: Detailed Structural Safety Assessment & Calculation Statement

inspection_types.name: Emergency / Special Inspection
inspection_types.purpose: Immediate assessment of structural integrity and traffic restriction requirements.
inspection_types.equipment: Emergency response team kit, laser distancemeter, dynamic displacement sensors.
inspection_types.deliverable: Emergency Safety Report with Immediate Action Plan & Lane Restriction
